identity_verification_semantics: Identity records are bibliographic/work-identity controls only. Multiple title/locator/type variants are exposed rather than collapsed into a strongest evidence record. Identity never certifies claim inspection, full-text access, passage support, or ranking readiness.

status_semantics.evidence_status: Use explicit evidence_status/evidenceStatus from the owning source record. If absent, emit NOT_EXPLICITLY_LABELED. Never substitute access_state.
status_semantics.inspection_scope: Exact depth recorded by the owning lane. It must not be inherited across claims merely because source_id matches.
status_semantics.inspection_depth_class: Conservative normalized audit class derived from the owning edge; unknown schemas fail closed for ranking/product-objective authoring.
status_semantics.claim_inspection_edge_id: Stable digest of candidate/source/owner/depth/limit/provenance. Product review should pin this edge instead of recreating depth from source identity.

field_provenance_rule: Source ownership is selected from the provenance of the effective source_minimum field, not from the candidate's latest unrelated override. A later status/keyed_concept/do_not_claim override must not cause an older source reference to inherit a later quorum lane.

owner_resolution.MATCHING_SOURCE_MINIMUM_PROVENANCE_LANE: The layer that last authored source_minimum contains exactly one explicit quorum/inspection-upgrade owner for this source ID.
owner_resolution.SOLE_IDENTITY_LEDGER_NO_DEPTH_INHERITANC: No matching source_minimum provenance lane owns the edge; one identity ledger exists and no later claim depth is inherited.
owner_resolution.SOLE_EXPLICIT_INSPECTION_LANE: No identity ledger exists and exactly one explicit source-control lane exists for this source ID.

fail_closed_conditions: multiple identity ledgers for a referenced source without an explicit claim owner
multiple inspection lanes with no source_minimum provenance match and no unique identity owner
latest candidate override is used as a proxy for source_minimum provenance
product card cannot identify an exact claim_inspection_edge_id and owning lane
